scope.input_model: raw Monotone2 translated to the augmented binary DAG with free FALSE/TRUE
scope.last_op: unset, or both AND and OR branches considered

base_compression: PASS: singleton supports are exact on nonempty independent inputs before first junk; forbidden support pairs enforce clean AND; edge values remain exact; MIS rows determine the monotone output including the empty input
all_live_clauses: PASS: a later reader for every gate below 20 plus output=20 is equivalent to every gate reaching output in the ordered DAG

lower_bound_dependency.free_constant_extension: constant propagation and alias deletion preserve retained AND functions and do not increase gate count

normalization_cases: PASS: a live junk must exist; dead17 repair uses a dirty prefix operand; the gate19=AND(18,18) exceptional first-live-junk case reduces to a forbidden clean circuit; suffix copy/relocation cases preserve output; prune prefix and OR-pad a live cut edge; re-sort

independent_tests.scope: Synthetic target x0 AND x1 tests reconstruction only. The actual graph lower bound separately excludes the exceptional/no-live-junk cases. No SAT solve or Lean build.

graph_tests.scope: Finite graph checks only; no solver or Lean build run.

specific_risks.detail: Assumptions line107 must mean new AND copies only at 18 and 19, then redirect the read of 17 in gate20 through 19. Preserve gate20 operation and its other operand; copying gate20 itself would be wrong.
Completeness is only for firstjunk17 with at least two junk ANDs. A single last-op branch or this shard alone does not cover all raw circuits.
The new normalization is mathematically reviewed but not Lean formalized. Solver UNSAT is not a checked refutation without certificate, encoding and normalization proofs.

Current gap imports list only PEqualNP.Defs besides Mathlib. L_meta_1407 cannot simply be imported in the final candidate; an admissible refutation would need the bound proved inside the permitted file or an explicitly permitted dependency.
Keep repeated operands, dead gates during normalization, and semantically redundant copies available. Do not replace structural liveness by semantic irredundancy.
Normalize unavailable raw reads to FALSE before pruning/renumbering; do not renumber raw out-of-range references as if they were ordinary DAG dependencies.
The prefix-to-suffix cut includes input/constant wires. In the augmented model firstjunk17 has binary operands, so it always supplies such an edge even if no original prefix gate survives.

work_performed: Source/theorem review plus small finite Python checks. No SAT solver, CNF generation, Lean build, source edits, desk calls or Git writes.
